# Lada N — Massage & Beauty Studio

> Massage, hair removal, permanent makeup and beauty services in central Kyiv, Ukraine. One studio at 10 Mala Zhytomyrska St., a few minutes' walk from Maidan Nezalezhnosti. Appointment by phone only — there is no online booking.

The studio belongs to Lada Novikova, its founder: a physical rehabilitation specialist by training (National University of Ukraine on Physical Education and Sport) who gives massage sessions herself. The rest of the team works under the studio's name.

The site is static HTML in three languages: Ukrainian at the root, Russian under `/ru/`, English under `/en/`. The same fifteen pages exist in every language, the address of a category is identical in all three, and every page carries its full price list in the served HTML — no script has to run to see a price.

## Pages

Ukrainian (default):

- [Home](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/): studio, services overview, full price list
- [Massage](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/massage/): full body, local and exotic massage
- [Hair removal](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/depilation/): waxing and sugaring, women and men
- [Permanent makeup](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/permanent/): brows, lips, eyeliner
- [Brows, lashes and makeup](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/beauty/): brow and lash treatments, makeup, hair styling

Russian: [/ru/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/), [/ru/massage/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/massage/), [/ru/depilation/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/depilation/), [/ru/permanent/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/permanent/), [/ru/beauty/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/ru/beauty/)

English: [/en/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/en/), [/en/massage/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/en/massage/), [/en/depilation/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/en/depilation/), [/en/permanent/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/en/permanent/), [/en/beauty/](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/en/beauty/)

## Services

- **Massage**: relaxation, therapeutic, author's, sports and four-hands sessions; local work on the neck, back, face, head, feet and hands; exotic techniques — Gua Sha, coconut bowls, anti-cellulite, cupping with stone therapy, Yumeiho, Tibetan honey and chocolate, Abhyanga, Shirodhara, lymphatic drainage
- **Hair removal**: waxing and sugaring (sugar paste), women and men, single zones and combos
- **Permanent makeup**: brows, lips, interlash and eyeliner; touch-up within 6 months costs 80% of the original price
- **Brows, lashes and makeup**: brow shaping and tinting, lash extensions and lamination, makeup, hair styling

Session prices are stated on every page in Ukrainian hryvnia. Duration-based services list a price per duration; a touch-up is priced as a share of the base procedure and has no fixed amount.

## Contact

- **Phone**: +380995570045, displayed on the site as (099) 557-00-45
- **Address**: Kyiv, 10 Mala Zhytomyrska St. (Maidan Nezalezhnosti)
- **Hours**: Daily 10:00 AM - 9:00 PM (10:00–21:00)
- **Appointment**: required, by phone; there is no online booking
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/lada_n_kyiv/

## Machine-readable

- [Sitemap](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/sitemap-index.xml): all fifteen pages with their language alternates
- [robots.txt](https://www.lada.kiev.ua/robots.txt)

Every page carries JSON-LD: the home page describes the business (address, hours, phone, price range, founder), each category page describes the service with its offers and a breadcrumb. Share-priced items are deliberately absent from the offer list — an offer without an amount would read as a free service.
